pages.title: Ground Zero Glass
pages.text: The extreme thermonuclear heat fused the desert sands into brilliant green $(2)Trinitite$(0) glass at the crater epicenter.$(br2)Due to crystalline atomic density, it can $(4)only be mined using a Netherite Pickaxe$(0).

pages.title: Alchemical Catalyst
pages.text: Trinitite retains exotic radioactive properties that bend the fabric of ordinary crafting. It serves as the irreplaceable structural heart of the $(5)Transmutation Cube$(0) and fuels advanced temporal catalysts.
